fact: ANPTIC's annual report for 2020 gives the Burkinabè state as the source of financing of its project to strengthen and extend RESINA, lists the mairie of Dédougou among the buildings given a local network and access to RESINA that year, and says that of the 10,251,103,000 FCFA it mobilised for projects in 2020, 2,123,197,000 FCFA (21.40%) came from the state budget and 78.60% from external financing.
title: Rapport annuel 2020
publisher: Agence nationale de promotion des technologies de l'information et de la communication (ANPTIC)
